Synthetic native `codex exec --json` fixture, producer baseline 0.163.0 (tag `rust-v0.163.0`), reviewed 2026-10-25. Primary source: https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/rust-v0.163.0/codex-rs/exec/src/exec_events.rs . This emitter, including collaboration and declined command status, is authoritative over the stale TypeScript SDK union. Coverage: thread/turn boundaries, command revisions and structured exit, MCP text vs opaque results, readable reasoning summary, assistant text and usage exclusion. Additional synthetic tests cover interruptions, child captures, collisions, retries, errors, additive/unknown records and unsupported history formats. No real transcript. Only this baseline is fixture-tested; not universal CLI compatibility. Native exec has no universal timestamps, model IDs or turn IDs. Child internals require explicit captures.

Identity policy: native identity keys are scoped to the explicitly supplied capture plus session/thread and, for Claude, agent. Local slugs follow first recognized display order. Only bounded ASCII identifier tokens are retained as metadata; recognized credential assignments are rejected from identifiers. Missing versions warn, untested numeric versions in the same major warn, and other majors/version spellings fail. Unknown additive fields are ignored; unknown kinds warn. Details are excluded unless explicitly enabled and are sanitized before event construction. Redaction is incomplete: inspect local output before submission. No token/cost accounting, test-success inference, inferred timing, automatic child discovery, agent execution or network access.
